distillation.definition: Mixology at Dyane Paris is built on raw ingredients, French wine spirit and slow infusions. Each recipe seeks a precise balance of intensity, freshness, texture and length, creating an exceptional ready-to-serve cocktail conceived in dialogue with its porcelain sculpture.
distillation.intro1: Each Dyane creation is born from a rare standard: achieving a balance few approach, and which one recognises immediately.
distillation.intro2: Crafted in France, in the heart of Vaucluse, our cuvées come to life in a territory where light, matter and time shape every detail.
distillation.origine_p1: We exclusively select raw ingredients: fresh ginger, whole vanilla pods, citrus zests, to preserve the purity of aromas.
distillation.origine_p2: Each element is chosen for its ability to express itself with precision, without artifice or correction.
distillation.origine_p3: This rigour in selection forms the foundation of every cuvée.
distillation.elaboration_titre: THE ELABORATION: WINE ALCOHOL AS FOUNDATION
distillation.elaboration_p1: At the heart of each creation lies a fundamental element: a wine alcohol of exceptional purity.
distillation.elaboration_p2: Derived from the transformation of wine, this alcohol is distinguished by its finesse, aromatic neutrality and ability to sublimate the ingredients it hosts.
distillation.elaboration_p3: It acts as a revealer, allowing notes of ginger, vanilla or citrus to unfold with precision and elegance.
distillation.elaboration_p4: Infusions are carried out slowly, over controlled durations, to extract every nuance without ever rushing the matter.
distillation.elaboration_p5: This long process yields an aromatic depth and stability that give the cuvée its character and signature.
distillation.signature_titre: THE SIGNATURE: A MASTERED SENSORY EXPERIENCE
distillation.signature_p1: Each recipe is conceived as a composition: a frank attack, an expressive heart, a persistent finish.
distillation.signature_p2: The balance between power and finesse is adjusted to the millilitre, until a rare harmony is achieved.
distillation.signature_p3: Nothing is left to chance: neither the texture, nor the structure, nor the way aromas evolve throughout the tasting.
distillation.signature_p4: At Dyane, the cocktail is no longer a mix. It is a liquid work of art.
distillation.citation: « EACH DYANE CUVÉE IS CONCEIVED AS A SELF-EVIDENT TRUTH: A BALANCE SO RIGHT IT ASSERTS ITSELF FROM THE VERY FIRST SIP. »

experiences.titre: COCKTAILS FOR LUXURY HOTELS AND EXCEPTIONAL EVENTS
experiences.video_label: Dyane Paris ready-to-serve cocktails and bespoke hospitality experiences
experiences.definition_titre: WHAT PREMIUM COCKTAIL SOLUTION WORKS FOR A LUXURY HOTEL?
experiences.definition: Dyane Paris offers luxury hotels a French solution for premium ready-to-serve cocktails, from the minibar and room service to the bar and events. The House can adapt the aromatic signature, format and presentation to each property while preserving a consistent recipe and allowing the hotel to shape its own service ritual.
experiences.intro1: Preparation and blending take place upstream in France. At service, teams remain free to choose temperature, ice, glassware, garnish and presentation.
experiences.intro2: This approach provides a premium alternative to making every cocktail entirely to order: it simplifies operations without removing the bartender’s gesture or the relationship with the guest.
experiences.signature_titre: SIGNATURE COCKTAILS FOR HOTELS AND EXCEPTIONAL HOUSES
experiences.signature_p1: A Dyane signature cocktail begins with the identity of the property, its service rhythm and the intended guest experience. Balance, intensity and aromatic expression can be adjusted to form a proposal consistent with the partner House.
experiences.signature_p2: At the bar or on the backbar, the cocktail arrives composed. The bartender retains control of finishing and presentation, while the work completed upstream helps preserve the same intention from one glass to the next.
experiences.signature_p3: Each batch is monitored from blending to bottling. Production remains deliberately contained and made to order, with consistency as its priority.
experiences.service_titre: A READY-TO-SERVE SOLUTION FOR THE MINIBAR AND ROOM SERVICE
experiences.service_p1: The individual 25 cL format is designed for a room, suite, premium minibar or welcome tray. It provides a composed cocktail that the hotel can pair with its own glassware and service ritual.
experiences.service_p2: For room service, upstream preparation makes a precise experience possible without requiring a bartender to be permanently present in every setting. Temperature, accompaniment and presentation remain under the property’s control.
experiences.service_p3: The porcelain sculpture forms part of the gesture: it gives the tray a distinctive presence and can be kept after tasting as a memory of the stay.
experiences.sur_mesure_p1: Dyane Paris studies the recipe, vessel and service context with each partner. Aromatic balance, finishes, artistic interventions and formats are considered together so that the liquid can reflect the identity of the place.
experiences.sur_mesure_p2: Existing uses range from the individual 25 cL format to 70 cL for service and the backbar. For receptions, professional 3 L, 5 L and 10 L Bag-in-Box formats support consistent preparation; sculptural projects can be adapted up to 12 L.
experiences.sur_mesure_p3: Each request begins with a conversation with the House to define what can be personalised and select a scale suited to the project.
experiences.evenement_titre: COCKTAILS AND WORKS FOR PRIVATE EVENTS
experiences.evenement_p1: For a reception, dinner or banqueting occasion, Dyane Paris can bring together a ready-to-serve cocktail, sculpture and scenography within one language. Larger formats preserve the consistency of the blend when many guests must be served with the same care.
experiences.evenement_p2: Teams retain control of pace, glassware, garnish and the final gesture. Upstream preparation makes service more fluid; it does not replace hospitality or finishing in front of the guest.
experiences.evenement_p3: The Concierge considers projects for hotels, restaurants, Houses and private events in France and internationally.

maison.titre: DYANE PARIS, HOUSE OF LIQUID ART
maison.definition_titre: WHAT IS A HOUSE OF LIQUID ART?
maison.definition: The House of Liquid Art is the creative territory developed by Dyane Paris to unite mixology, sculpture and fine craft. Each exceptional cocktail is presented in a hand-painted porcelain sculpture designed to remain as a collectible object after the tasting experience.
maison.intro: Dyane Paris was born in Paris in 2025 from a founding intuition: to elevate the cocktail to a work of art in its own right. The Maison was built around a precise idea. To reconcile gesture, matter and taste. To transform the moment of tasting into a lasting aesthetic experience.
maison.genese_p1: Dyane draws its inspiration from the mythological figure of Diana, goddess of the hunt. A free, independent and sovereign figure.
maison.genese_p2: Guardian of forests and natural cycles. The Maison retains from this symbolism the mastery, the precision of gesture and the silent exigence.
maison.genese_p3: The hunt here is not predation but a quest. A quest for rightness, a quest for balance, a quest for beauty.
maison.art_titre: THE BIRTH OF A LIQUID ART HOUSE
maison.art_p1: Dyane Paris is a French House bringing art and mixology together. It defines itself neither as a simple spirits brand nor as a ready-to-drink category.
maison.art_p2: The Maison claims its own identity: Liquid Art. Each creation combines a signature cocktail, crafted with exigence, with an artistic container designed to be kept. Drinking becomes a gesture. Keeping becomes a memory.
maison.art_p3: The break is deliberate. Dyane abandons the traditional glass bottle for porcelain. A noble, enduring, sculptural material. The form evokes a presence.
maison.art_p4: It exists in a space as an autonomous work. Once the cocktail is savoured, the object remains. It transcends time and becomes part of an interior.
maison.temps_p1: The Maison relies on a demanding artisanal process divided between Vaucluse and Île-de-France. The porcelain is born from mineral work, transformed, moulded, fired through a long cycle.
maison.temps_p2: The cocktails are crafted from French wine alcohol, produced after the harvest and worked through infusion. Each Dyane creation mobilises more than 70 pairs of hands from kaolin powder to final tasting. Production is deliberately limited.
maison.contemporaine_p: Dyane is part of an evolution of luxury. A luxury that is rarer than demonstrative. More enduring than consumable.

oeuvres.intro_eyebrow: DYANE PARIS — HOUSE OF LIQUID ART
oeuvres.intro_lead: A Dyane Paris luxury cocktail combines a ready-to-serve recipe crafted in France with a hand-painted porcelain sculpture. Tasting becomes a ritual, while the vessel is designed to remain and take its place among collectible art objects.
oeuvres.collector_title: THE LUXURY COCKTAIL AS A COLLECTIBLE WORK
oeuvres.collector_body: Dyane No.1 reinterprets the Pornstar Martini and Dyane No.2 the Moscow Mule. Each creation brings together mixology, sculpture and porcelain in a signature form, while collaborations and bespoke commissions extend the collection.
oeuvres.no1_sous_titre: The audacity of the Pornstar Martini sublimated in a creation with indulgent nuances.
oeuvres.no2_sous_titre: A sophisticated interpretation of the mythical Moscow Mule.
oeuvres.teo_sous_titre: In collaboration with painter Matteo Mengacci, better known as Teo Kaykay.
